description.value: Take Sushi is a Japanese restaurant on East Hastings Street in Burnaby offering an extensive menu of maki rolls, nigiri, sashimi, hot dishes, and combos. The restaurant has an active online ordering platform with quick pickup options, making it a practical meal stop for cyclists passing through the area. With over 210 customer reviews, it is a well-established neighbourhood spot with a broad menu that includes numerous vegetarian-friendly items.
